This independently compiled Java interface and open implementation share the
encoded JVM name of an unrelated anonymous final carrier target. Their return
descriptors differ. Encoding changes only the exact UTF8 name entries, preserving
Code and descriptors. The frozen observer checks concrete and interface
reflection, an immutable static caller with interface dispatch, and method
handles, including wide edge
values, partial writes, null receivers and exact exception identity. A wrong
implementation that writes its second field before throwing must fail.
